business.headline: Sensex opens 200 points higher, Nifty above 25,800; Infosys up 3%The Sensex was up 42.63 points, or 0.05%, at 83,980.91. It opened at 84,301.40 and touched an early high of 84,326.40, while the day's low so far was 83,893.39. The Nifty 50 was down 47.75 points, or 0.18%, at 25,771.50 as of 9:25 am.

Tata Sons to call EGM for Chandra reappointment, push IPO plan; Noel Tata objectsTata Sons' board will consider its IPO plan and N Chandrasekaran's reappointment amid Noel Tata's objections. The decisions could shape compliance with the RBI directive and the company's proposed listing route.

Air India shifts west-bound traffic to Mumbai: What's behind the move?Acknowledging the impact of regional airspace restrictions, Air India CEO Tewolde Gebremariam told employees during a town hall that the airline was redesigning parts of its network to improve efficiency and minimise disruptions.

PhonePe revives IPO plans, targets $15 billion valuation for 2027 listingThe proposed IPO is expected to be entirely an offer for sale (OFS), meaning existing shareholders will sell part or all of their holdings rather than the company issuing fresh shares to raise money.

India needs 80 lakh jobs a year: Can cheaper imports be the answer?Millions of young Indians are entering the workforce, but are there enough jobs waiting for them? Could cheaper imports help India tackle its growing employment challenge?

TVS family feud: Lakshmi Venu open to settlement despite 'ship has sailed' remarkLakshmi Venu remains willing to discuss an amicable property settlement with her family. The court battle centres on a disputed 5:95 division and daughters' equal rights.

94% of popular online platforms still use dark patterns despite govt crackdownA LocalCircles study found dark patterns on 334 of 354 online platforms examined across India. The findings reveal a wide compliance gap before amended e-commerce rules take effect.

Sensex ends 1,502 points higher, Nifty above 25,800; HUL up 6%The Sensex surged 1,502.29 points, or 1.82%, to close at 83,938.28. The index had opened at 83,436.89 and moved between an intraday low of 83,380.75 and a high of 84,498.21. The Nifty gained 469.60 points, or 1.85%, to settle at 25,819.25.

Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy steps down after 11 yearsKrishnamurthy took over as Flipkart CEO in January 2017 and was elevated to Group CEO in 2018, leading the company's expansion across key businesses.

TVS succession row: Lakshmi Venu files suit seeking partition of father's assetsIn the suit, Lakshmi has sought the partition of joint family assets belonging to the Venu Srinivasan branch of the TVS family and the allotment of her rightful share.

Nvidia, Trump and a boardroom precedent that could worry companies worldwideA CEO is back, a President is taking credit, and Nvidia's board is facing questions about its independence. Could this set a precedent for corporate boardrooms worldwide?

Tamil Nadu eyes over Rs 50,000 crore investments across sectorsIn August, the Tamil Nadu government signed nearly 100 investment agreements at its first investor meeting since Chief Minister Joseph Vijay took office.

Air India CEO Tewolde gets go-ahead for major leadership shake-up: ReportTata Sons chairman has given Tewolde Gebremariam the freedom to build his own leadership team, including hiring senior executives from outside the company who have experience in running large airlines, says report.

GTA V to GTA VI: How India became an electronics manufacturing powerhouseMore than a decade separates GTA V and GTA VI, but those years also saw India emerge as a major electronics manufacturing hub. How did that transformation happen?

Sensex surges nearly 2,000 points, Rs 4 lakh crore added: Why stock markets are rallyingWhile concerns over an AI bubble and the sustainability of massive investments in AI infra continue to trigger sharp swings in technology-heavy markets, Dalal Street has found its footing, with foreign investors returning, corporate earnings improving and lower crude oil prices offering support.

Bulls take charge on Dalal Street as Sensex, Nifty rally amid global jittersThe Sensex was up 1,363.85 points, or 1.65%, at 83,799.84. It opened at 83,436.89, against its previous close of 82,435.99, and climbed to an early high of 83,869.60. The Nifty 50 rose 388.90 points, or 1.53%, to 25,738.55 as of 9:24 am.

Joining WhatsApp stock tip groups? Sebi lists 11 ways to spot fake trading scamsSebi has warned investors against fake WhatsApp and Telegram groups impersonating registered intermediaries. The alert highlights deceptive trading offers and urges verification through official regulatory resources.

RBI's new digital fraud rules: What changes for your bank account, cards, transfers?One of the biggest changes is a proposed 'Stop Switch' facility that would allow customers to immediately disable all future customer-initiated debits from their accounts. The RBI has also proposed a Trusted Person Mechanism, under which another person chosen by the customer could be asked to approve certain high-value fund transfers.

Claude maker Anthropic crashes below $83 IPO price, putting $200 billion at riskAnthropic shares fell below their $83 IPO price days after a record Nasdaq debut. The reversal intensified concerns over AI valuations, insider selling and infrastructure costs.

entertainment.headline: He has to be flawless: Ayushmann on playing Mr Darcy-like Prem in Yeh Prem Mol Liya Ayushmann Khurrana has discussed playing Prem and supporting one's spouse after marriage. His remarks underline the character's idealism and the responsibility attached to the role.

Bollywood spent years chasing South market. Ramayana finally conquered it Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana has broken Bollywood box office records across several southern markets, becoming the first of its kind. Its dubbed versions have emerged as major contributors to the film's nationwide success.

Fawad Khan calls Netflix's Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo a 'win for Pakistan' Fawad Khan hailed Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo as a win for Pakistan at its Karachi trailer launch. The Netflix series promises wider global access to Pakistani stories but faces opposition over its proposed India release.

Two OTT homes for one blockbuster! Hanuman Ansh gets six-language digital rollout Hanuman Ansh, based on the life of Neem Karoli Baba, is taking a two-platform route for its OTT release. The film will reach viewers in six languages, while producer Anupriya Nagar has also confirmed that a sequel is in the works.

Ramayana box office Day 21: Pushpa 2 dethroned, film storms into all-time Top 4 Ranbir Kapoor and Yash-starrer Ramayana has overtaken Allu Arjun's Pushpa 2 at the worldwide box office. The milestone places director Nitesh Tiwari's epic among the four highest-grossing Indian films.

Angelina Jolie, Brad Pitt settle bitter legal battle over French winery Hollywood actors Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt have settled their long-running legal battle over their French winery, Chateau Miraval. The former couple's dispute involved their divorce, a $64 million sale and allegations of abuse.

You think you're Anup Jalota? Twinkle raps Akshay for 6 am bhajan on Koffee call Author Twinkle Khanna roasted her husband, actor Akshay Kumar, during a surprise phone call on Koffee With Karan 9. The exchange highlighted their banter as Bhojpuri actor Ravi Kishan joined the episode's playful mood.

Rs 24 in his bank account, Rs 1 crore on KBC: Meet season 18's first crorepati Bhushan Thakare became Kaun Banega Crorepati 18's first crorepati after arriving in Mumbai with Rs 24 in his bank account. His decade-long pursuit has secured funds to resume UPSC preparation and support his family.

Our religion, not beach accessory: Internet schools Kendall Jenner over 'Om' sarong Kendall Jenner faced criticism after wearing an Om and Trishul-printed sarong, sparking a debate on cultural sensitivity and respect. Many argue that religious icons like Om should not be treated as fashion accessories, highlighting the need for awareness and respect towards spiritual traditions.

He wanted to kill me: Ravi Kishan recalls father's fury over acting on KWK 9 Actor-politician Ravi Kishan opened up about his early struggles on Koffee With Karan Season 9 alongside Akshay Kumar. He recalled how his father violently opposed his acting ambitions in the 1990s, forcing his mother to help him leave home.

Honey Singh, Atif Aslam dance at Dubai wedding amid Pak show ban row Singers Honey Singh and Atif Aslam danced to Abrar-ul-Haq's songs at a Dubai wedding, with the event host sharing photos and videos, while referencing the ongoing ban calls against Pakistani Netflix series Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo.

Doctor jailed for negligence that led to Ismail Darbar's mother's death in 2009 A Surat court sentenced Paresh Bhajiawala to two years in prison for medical negligence. The verdict concludes a 17-year legal battle over Ismail Darbar's mother, Zaitoon Bibi's death.

Producer alleges police harassment during Indore shoot, cops deny claims A web series shoot in Indore ended in a dispute after producer Kapil Khadiwala accused Indore police of disrupting filming and demanding money. Indore Police Commissioner Santosh Singh dismissed the allegations as misleading and said a notice had been issued to the producer.

Trump backs Robert Pattinson as Bond, revisits old Kristen Stewart tweet Donald Trump wished Robert Pattinson luck as James Bond during an Oval Office interview. He also revisited his 2012 comments on Pattinson's relationship with Kristen Stewart.

O Saathi Re trailer: Arjun's entry strains Aditi-Avinash marriage Netflix unveiled the O Saathi Re trailer, tracing Roshni and Karan's marriage towards divorce. Arjun Rampal's character deepens their conflict as Roshni seeks an identity beyond prescribed roles.

SS Rajamouli's Varanasi to skip April 2027 release over VFX, post-production delay SS Rajamouli's Varanasi may miss its April 2027 release as extensive VFX work continues. The announced date remains unchanged pending official confirmation from the makers.

Nathan Fielder reveals why he agreed to make Elizabeth Holmes documentary Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim filmed Elizabeth Holmes and her family for three years. The documentary examines the divide between her public persona and private presentation.

Ramayana in Oscars Best Visual Effects longlist beside Doomsday, Dune 3, The Odyssey Director Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend has secured a place on the 20-film Best Visual Effects longlist for the 2027 Academy Awards. Backed by DNEG's VFX work, it competes alongside Dune: Part Three, Avengers: Doomsday, Project Hail Mary, and The Odyssey.

general news.headline: Singur's 997 acres: Said Tata to Nano 20 years ago, will welcome Ashok Leyland nowSingur was where then West Bengal CM Buddhadeb Bhattacharya's ambitious industrialisation drive unravelled in 2006, forcing Tata Motors to abandon its Nano factory. Two decades later, CM Suvendu Adhikari is looking to turn the same 997 acres in Singur into an industrial hub, starting with an Ashok Leyland truck-manufacturing factory.

Why US is attacking Make in India, Atmanirbhar Bharat in new tariff threatThe US Trade Representative has determined that India's acts, policies and practices relating to structural excess capacity and production are "unreasonable" and burden or restrict US commerce. It has proposed tariffs of up to 25 per cent on Indian goods, to which New Delhi has responded by rejecting the charge.

SRK sends defamation notice to influencer over viral Anant Ambani interaction reelA viral video showing Shah Rukh Khan interacting with Anant Ambani during a meeting with Sadhguru sparked claims that the actor was asked to remain silent, allegations his legal team has dismissed as false and defamatory.

Return or quit: IBM gives H-1B employees only 2 optionsThe IBM has ended US visa sponsorship and green card for most positions in its consulting division, leaving impacted employees with only two choices: relocate to another country or leave the company. Furthermore, the employees reportedly have only three weeks to decide.

Uncovering the 'Major General Sahab' from 26/11Listed only by rank in the Mumbai Police's chargesheet on the 26/11 attacks, this shadow Pakistani commander oversaw one of the deadliest terror strikes against India.

Birth certificate denied for newborn after father's name deleted from voter listA newborn in West Bengal's Cooch Behar has been denied a birth certificate for over two months, with her family alleging that her father's name being deleted from the voter list during the SIR exercise has stalled the registration process.

Why Punjab is double the challenge for BJP-Akali Dal allianceThe BJP and SAD might have reunited to strengthen their electoral prospects, but the partnership of the long-time allies faces challenges on various fronts. From transferring votes and tackling the drug menace to reclaiming the Panthic vote, the alliance has doubled its political challenges even before the 2027 Punjab Assembly elections.

Pak series Dar-e-Nijaat screenings cancelled in Bengaluru after backlashOrganisers cancelled two Bengaluru screenings of Pakistani drama Dar-e-Nijaat after facing social media backlash, while police said neither event had been granted permission.

Live: Congress, SP to hold nationwide protests against CEC on Constitution DayConstitution Day Rally Live Updates: Constitution Day 2026 will see political activity across the country, with the Congress organising 'Samvidhan Raksha Marches' in several states to protest against alleged electoral irregularities and demand the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge will lead the march in Lucknow, while protests are planned in Delhi, Uttarakhand, Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat. In Nagpur, the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), joined by actor-activist Prakash Raj, will hold a 'Save Democracy, Save Constitution' protest. Meanwhile, the Samajwadi Party and AIMIM are also set to hold key political events in Lucknow as parties mark Constitution Day.

US says no proof China sent Alice Huang to seduce, spy on Nvidia chief: ReportAccording to the New York Times, US intelligence officials told congressional aides there was no evidence China directed Alice Huang to spy on Jensen Huang. No dowry, just Re 1: Haryana sarpanch sets example with son's marriageA sarpanch in Haryana's Bhiwani refused gold and silver jewellery worth lakhs and Rs 11 lakh in cash offered by the bride's family, fixing his son's marriage for just Re 1. The family said it wanted to send a message against dowry.

Himachal man, 75, marries 63-year-old woman at old-age home where they found loveA 75-year-old man from Himachal Pradesh married a 63-year-old woman after finding companionship at a Bilaspur old-age home. Their late-life union marked a new chapter after years of loneliness and hardship.

Dismiss me, I'll stay with Samajwadi: Suspended UP cop eyes Assembly poll ticketSuspended constable Shyam Sunder Chauhan has told an enquiry officer he will remain with the Samajwadi Party even if dismissed. Anant Singh invited all to daughter's wedding. Chaos arrived, and 10-km-long jam tooBihar strongman and Mokama MLA Anant Singh's open invitation to his daughter Shivangi's wedding drew massive crowds to his ancestral village of Nadwan, triggering a 10-km-long traffic jam. While people climbed electricity towers to watch a horse race, the organisers were forced to postpone the final amid the chaos.

Not AI: Man on moving bike takes unbelievable one-handed catch, video goes viralA cricket fan in Pakistan, Mehran Khan, has pulled off a stunning one-handed catch while sitting pillion on a moving motorcycle. sports.headline: UCL: United denied by late blunder, PSG held by Roma, Bayern stunned by Lille Manchester United were denied a win by a late blunder, PSG's unbeaten run ended in a draw against Roma and Bayern Munich suffered a shock defeat to Lille as Barcelona and Liverpool picked up comfortable wins in a dramatic Champions League night.

No Sinner in Melbourne: Australian Open confirms Italian's withdrawal in 2027 Jannik Sinner has been ruled out of the Australian Open 2027 after undergoing minor surgery on his right knee. The two-time Melbourne champion will prioritise recovery, with tournament organisers confirming he will miss January's Grand Slam.

Stokes calls for truth in Sandpapergate, highlights toll on players and families Former England captain Ben Stokes has called for the truth to emerge over Sandpapergate, saying Cricket Australia's leadership at the time has questions to answer and highlighting the toll the controversy has taken on players and their families.

Neuer spotted with physiotherapist after split from wife following childbirth Manuel Neuer was spotted with a mystery woman in Brazil after splitting from wife Anika following the birth of their second child. Gukesh defends quick draw in Game 2, admits he could not put Sindarov under pressure D Gukesh settled for a second successive draw against Javokhir Sindarov after Game 2 of the FIDE World Chess Championship ended in just 20 moves. The Indian admitted he could not find a way to put his opponent under pressure but defended his choice of the London System.

Ravindra Jadeja joins Vaibhav Sooryavanshi celebrations with fun edited picture Ravindra Jadeja joined the celebrations after Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's sensational 204 against UAE, sharing a fun edited picture of the teenager on Instagram. Sooryavanshi smashed 28 sixes in his knock to help India A chase down 250 and qualify for the Rising Stars Asia Cup semi-finals.

India women's hockey team scales new heights with historic rise to World No.4 The Indian women's hockey team climbed to a historic World No. 4 in the FIH Rankings after thrashing Japan 4-0 in the Women's Asian Champions Trophy 2026 in Bhopal. India broke their own record for the second consecutive day, having reached World No. 5 after defeating China 6-2 on Tuesday.

Sindarov comfortably neutralised Gukesh's London System, leaving the defending champion with little to show for his first outing with the white pieces.

Wiaan Mulder scripts history as South Africa crush Bangladesh to seal 2-0 series win SA vs BAN: Wiaan Mulder scripted history with a century and a seven-wicket haul as South Africa crushed Bangladesh by an innings and 219 runs in the second Test in Centurion to complete a 2-0 series sweep.

Riding high on Vaibhav Sooryavanshi storm, India A eye Sri Lanka A heist in semisIndia A will bank on Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking double century against the UAE as they take on unbeaten Sri Lanka A in the Rising Stars Asia Cup semi-final. Mumbai-Goa sailing spectacle: Ocean Gold Cup Season 2 to begin on January 4The Ocean Gold Cup will return for its second season from January 4 to 10, 2027, featuring a 250-nautical-mile offshore sailing race from Mumbai to Goa. Rohit Sharma, is that you? Mumbai Indians tease IPL 2027 captain announcementIPL 2027: Mumbai Indians sent fans on social media into a frenzy with a cryptic image on Wednesday. Speculation is rife that Rohit Sharma will return as captain of the five-time champions.

Delhi to host 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup, 2027 World Champs in Olympics styleNew Delhi will host the 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup Finals as the BWF expands its team championships to 24 teams. The World Championships will adopt an Olympic-style group-stage format from 2027, alongside other major changes.

WBBL: Deandra Dottin loses her wicket before facing a ball in bizarre Free Ball twistDeandra Dottin suffered a bizarre dismissal in the WBBL as Sarah Glenn hit the unguarded stumps after the West Indies all-rounder failed to reach the crease within the 75-second time limit.
